notes: Runtime support uses a third-party MUST PV/PH18 Modbus map for read-only telemetry.

known_limitations: Read-only first implementation; no write controls are exposed.
Requires collector serial settings compatible with Modbus RTU 19200 8N1 and inverter slave address 4.
Telemetry map is based on a third-party MUST PV/PH18 Modbus register map and still needs owner confirmation through a fresh support archive after integration update.
knowledge_summary: MUST PV18-3024 support is based on issue #5 support archives and a third-party MUST PV/PH18 Modbus register map. The user archives showed Auto/PI30 probe timeouts, SmartESS protocol asset "02FF,0,0," and collector serial baudrate 19200-8-1-0. The runtime adds a read-only MUST PV/PH18 Modbus surface using slave address 4 and the third-party register map.
